sections.Profile:
"Karting" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1962. Designed for two players, it features two flippers, four pop bumpers, and two slingshots.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1962
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Go karts, Two player, Racing, Original Theme, Cars
